# QYL0111: Start spans through the generated starters

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |

| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0111RawActivitySourceAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

A hand-made ActivitySource is unregistered until something subscribes it, and its StartActivity calls carry no registry kind, name or attributes. The generated starters on Qyl.Spans and Qyl.IncubatingSpans start every span on the registry-owned Qyl.Telemetry.Application scope that AddQyl subscribes. Instrumentation libraries that own their ActivitySources set the MSBuild property OtelSemConvInstrumentationLibrary to true.
